title: Ten minutes after opening, since the fix: the early desk answers on the first ring
purpose: Story S3, after the fix. A caller who expected a recording gets Maya at 07:40. She asks where the screw is, gives the price with what would change it, offers eight o'clock, books and sums up with the address. Short, and the kind of call that used to ring out.

call.day: slot 6's 8th working day before T, 07:40, ten minutes after opening (rule R6; card S03, call 32)

scenario.who_calls: A first-time caller, Jared Scruggs, on his way to work, expecting to leave a message.
scenario.job: flat repair: patch-plug and rebalance, right rear
scenario.wants: a price to plug a tire that keeps going low
scenario.what_happens: Maya asks which tire, where the screw sits and how long he has been airing it up, gives the price and what would make it a new tire instead, offers eight o'clock, takes his name, books and sums up with the address.

facts.note: catalogue.json tyre_repair: 31.00 (a menu price). Since the fix two advisors work from 07:30 (card S03).

script.said: Thanks for calling Brennan Auto Care, this is Maya. How can I help you?
Oh! Hey. I didn't figure anybody'd pick up this early. I was gonna leave a message.
Nope, we're here! What can I do for you?
I got — I got a tire that keeps goin' low. Every mornin' the light's on. I think I picked up a nail.
Okay. Which tire is it, do you know?
Passenger rear.
And can you see the nail? Is it in the tread, like the flat part, or over toward the edge?
It's a screw, actually. It's in the tread. Kinda the middle.
Okay, that's the good spot. How long have you been airing it up?
'Bout a week. I put — I put air in it every other day. What do y'all charge to plug it?

So if it's in the tread like you're saying, we patch it from the inside and rebalance it, and that's thirty-one dollars. If it turns out to be in the shoulder, or the tire's been run low enough to hurt it, we can't patch that, and then we'd be talking about a tire. But I can get you in this morning at eight. Can you make that?
Okay.
Eight? Like, twenty minutes from now?
Yep! First one in.
Yeah, I can do that. I'm ten minutes away.
Perfect. What's your name?
Jared Scruggs.
Okay, Jared. I've got you down for eight this morning, and I'll check you in myself. What are you driving?
Twenty-nineteen RAV4.
Okay. So that's eight o'clock this morning, here at twenty-one-oh-six East Main Street, and we're patching the right rear on the RAV4.
Yep.
Sounds good. See you in a few.
See you soon, Jared!
